name: Thinking_6
short_caption: The robot tilts its head slightly while placing its right hand near its hip in a thoughtful pose.
movement_description: The robot begins by raising its right arm, bending the elbow to place its right hand open and downward-facing near its hip, while simultaneously tilting its head slightly to the left. It holds this pensive posture for a couple of seconds, maintaining a steady gaze forward. Finally, it smoothly lowers its right arm back to its side and returns its head to a level, neutral position.
